ruleDefinitions.name: Odbcconf.EXE Suspicious DLL Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "odbcconf" where the path of the DLL being registered is located in a potentially suspicious location.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\odbcconf\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "odbcconf\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Registration\\\\CRMLog.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\com\\\\dmp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\FxsTmp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Microsoft\\\\Crypto\\\\RSA\\\\MachineKeys\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\drivers\\\\color\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\PRINTERS\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\SERVERS\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\_Migrated\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\SyncCenter\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\com\\\\dmp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\FxsTmp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\Tasks\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\PLA\\\\System\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\Tasks\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\SyncCenter\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tracing\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\.*")))
